Ready your horses and saddle up, because Update 1.40: Roam Together has officially arrived! This marks our final update for 2025, and it’s a big one. If you’ve been keeping up with our announcements over the past few weeks, you’ll know there’s plenty to dive into. We’ve put a lot of love into this update, and we’re excited to finally share it with you in full.
There’s plenty to explore, so let’s jump right in and see what’s new.
Multiplayer Free Roam is here!
For the very first time, you can explore the world of Rival Stars Horse Racing with up to eight friends in Free Roam Multiplayer!

Gallop together across the open fields of the Ranch, wander through the lush, rolling landscapes of Switzerland, tackle the rugged trails of Canyon Falls, or race across the golden sands of Golden Dunes. Every corner of the world is yours to discover, and there’s so much to see and do.

Express yourself in-game using fun emotes while you ride, master jumps alongside your friends, uncover every hidden nook and cranny of the map, or snap the perfect shot using the camera feature. Free Roam is all about enjoying the journey together.

Getting started is easy! Once you reach Prestige 3, the multiplayer game mode will unlock. Head to the Race and Ride menu and select the multiplayer game mode, then click on Free Roam. From there, you can create a private room and share the code with your friends, or hop into a public lobby to meet other players exploring the world.
Whether you’re racing, roaming, or just enjoying the scenery, Free Roam Multiplayer brings a whole new level of adventure to Rival Stars Horse Racing.

Show Jumping is finally stepping out of Free Roam and into its very own Career mode! It’s your chance to level up your skills, explore new arenas, and work your way through four unique Leagues, each with its own vibe and challenges.

You’ll kick things off at Club, the first location in the League. Think of it as your warm-up arena – the place where you get comfy with the controls and learn the ropes before moving on to the National League, Sponsored League, and eventually the ultimate stage: the Grand Prix.
Each location has six courses, giving you a total of 24 to take on. Every course brings something new to learn, with fresh layouts, obstacles, and moments to nail that perfect jump.

Progression in Career mode is all about earning Reputation Points. As you complete courses, you’ll unlock new challenges, bigger arenas, and fresh locations to explore. Every League feels like a new step up and a new world to ride in.
Whether you’re chasing clean rounds, going for a PB, or just enjoying each new arena, Show Jumping Career adds a fun new way to ride in Rival Stars Horse Racing.

Say hello to the newest breed in Rival Stars Horse Racing: the French Chaser, also known as the Autre Que Pur-Sang (AQPS)! First established in 2005, this breed combines the agility of the Thoroughbred with the strength of the Selle Français, making them versatile athletes ready to take on a variety of challenges.

French Chasers are celebrated for their adaptability, excelling across multiple events far beyond what they were originally bred for, so whether you’re sprinting across open fields or mastering tough jumps, these horses have the skill to shine.
In-game, French Chasers come with a breed bonus to give you an edge:
+5 Sprint Energy
+2 Jump

Welcome to the latest update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition! Update 1.33 has arrived, bringing new missions, fresh story content, and a brand-new breed to the ranch.

This update expands on cross country and steeplechase with new goals to chase and even more compelling story to unfold. Whether you’re here for the story or simply to welcome a new horse to your ranch, there’s plenty to discover.
Introducing, for the very first time on the Rival Stars Ranch, The Anglo-Arab!

Originating in France, the Anglo-Arab blends the endurance and spirit of the Arabian with the speed and strength of the Thoroughbred. This balance makes it a natural all-rounder, well-suited for all types of events and rides, from flat racing to cross-country, show jumping and beyond.
+5 Agility
+2 Sprint Energy

Alongside this new breed comes the Braided Mane, an elegant new trait you can add to your horses in the Horse Creator or pass down through breeding to create generations of gorgeous champions. This trait has a 40% chance of appearing on Anglo Arabs, and a 10% chance of appearing on any other horse.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/234c82a387d43ab2cffa00ddedae8dedcd392447.png"]
Two storylines are expanding in this update, bringing new depth to both Cross Country and Steeplechase.
Cross Country continues with four additional chapters, featuring fresh missions and the return of Richard, whose presence adds new rivalries and opportunities to the competition.

Steeplechase is getting its first set of story missions. The opening three chapters follow a journey shaped by family legacy and the arrival of Alex, a new character who sparks rivalries as the tournament approaches.
Together, these chapters introduce new challenges, new faces, and the next stage of your racing story.

notes.title: Welcome to the latest update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition! Update 1.32 – Golden Shimmer has arrived, and it’s a big one.

items.text: This update introduces a brand new breed, a stunning new environment, and a variety of quality-of-life improvements to keep things running smoothly. Whether you're here for the horses, the story, or the scenery, there’s something for everyone. It’s a packed update, so let’s jump into the full notes!
Sleek, fast, and sure to turn heads, the Akhal-Teke has officially arrived on Desktop.

With roots in the desert and a reputation for endurance, this breed is known for its athletic build and signature golden shimmer. Whether you’re racing or just showing off in the pasture, the Akhal-Teke brings both style and strength.
It’s not just a pretty face either. This debut comes with a powerful Breed Bonus:
+5 Speed
+2 Sprint Energy
Get ready to add something truly special to your stables.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfHtrroep0EYfVDIj1LutSqg0QH94IvzBsIIKv8S_NzNj3IZPGslgoEp61ZX5g9aWyeR3b2iR3lfsuZ1O94ie4vlsK-3pwV7KXFTSHmpadL6vPXGFIMhMewgUyex5Duq4lJEO0JXg?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"]

Our last update introduced the first-ever trait to the desktop version: the Long Mane trait. In this update, we’re excited to introduce another trait, the Crystal Coat, which arrives with the Akhal-Teke. Just like the Long Mane, the Crystal Coat is a visual trait that gives horses a sleek, glossy finish that helps them stand out. This trait can be acquired on any horse and can be stacked with the Long Mane Trait.
And thats not all, Traits can now be toggled on and off in the Horse Creator screen and are also now visible on the horse info screen

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGFtigvjuyPPWFvO5dpMZf5td4_urQc5hPyWHtROwKLg5BF-Nd9bq3nlzWeaqi6xkV-z-jOJW4Ja0Dw8FDnGSJV3bHP2ZtIQoSmkYTnwX3icPLlixtURQR-RHmTYHqqglPChoufg?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"]
Get ready to gallop to an epic new area. Welcome to the Golden Dunes

This beautiful desert landscape features winding village streets and distinctive clay buildings full of character. Soft golden sand dunes stretch out across the horizon, creating a warm and open setting. Along the paths, palm trees and desert greenery offer welcome shade as you ride. A peaceful oasis provides a quiet spot to pause and take in the view. It’s a sunlit, inviting place that’s perfect for relaxed rides and stunning photo opportunities.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe7Ihx5_a-JxvgGDtrP4RmfGuM4uYKo17jhBqVu1BTGJz0WbTLlzb6YIcAhFtsHs-3sYA65GLPj6Lu1AZpbuPuII1CZOaIhFMjcgYZT3L1cdZou1kqyIHST7u_uxCwvI08I4hy8RQ?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"]
A brand new addition to photo mode has landed in Rival Stars Horse Racing Desktop Edition.

We’ve added a feature that lets you advance time at a slower pace while in camera mode, making it easier than ever to capture that perfect mid-jump shot, your horse galloping through the Golden Dunes or a serene moment by the oasis. [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfFW71DxY2SCe5lE-kC9MWiIQHJf0F8nLsdujVCWXxCigyg_Dz8t4mxBNVlfmVedywkEOffRl-r5YnbYwlgIZcqriWfhZYDvGTS7vHwK8XGz2Iv8vdYoJZH3jOw_xBy-HURuU8DtQ?key=jzeMdYFLvnONjSC6zjw6hg"]

notes.title: Welcome to the latest Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition update notes

items.text: In this update, we’re adding not just one but two new breeds! If you’ve been paying attention to our posts recently, you will have seen us teasing the Mustang breed, but if you looked a little closer, you might’ve spotted another familiar pattern starting to appear in the background. Yep, that’s the Appaloosa, and alongside the Mustang, they’re ready to join your stables.
It’s a packed update with plenty to explore. Alongside the new breeds, we’ve added new coats, a new dilution, and a handful of fun extras. - Let's jump into the update notes

notes.title: Welcome to the stable, Mustang and Appaloosa!

items.text: Mustang

The Mustang is built for adventure. With the stamina to roam and the speed to keep other horses on their toes, it's a great fit for all kinds of disciplines. And while it can dominate Flat Racing or charge through steeplechase, it's just as comfortable tackling the rugged trails of Canyon Falls. Whether you're out exploring or just soaking up the view, the Mustang brings bold energy wherever it goes.
Mustang Breed Bonus
+5 Sprint Energy
+2 Acceleration
Long Mane
We can't bring the Mustang to desktop without including its iconic Long Mane.
Mustang horses have a high chance of having a long mane, and this mane has a chance to be passed down to foals of all different breeds
Appoloosa
Surprise! The Appaloosa is also joining the stables alongside the mustang

This striking breed is now available in Rival Stars Horse Racing. Known for its unique spotted coat and calm, friendly nature, the Appaloosa has earned a special place in the hearts of riders around the world. Known for their gentle temperament, Appaloosas are just as comfortable on the race track as they are in the show ring or on the trails.
Appoloosa Breed Bonus
+5 Acceleration
+2 Jump
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37468018/d00635bc174440223b9bac5cb5e9379ade6aa39f.png"]

The Dun dilution is now available in the horse creator. This new Dilution adds more range to how your horses can look, with some subtle differences in tone and shading. We can’t wait to see the horses you create with it.

We’ve added a couple of quality of life changes to improve your experience. First up, you can now rotate your horse in both the horse details menu and the horse creator. Whether you're checking out a new pattern, reviewing your customisation choices, or just admiring your horse, you can now see it from every angle.

There’s also a new settings button on the save file selection screen. This lets you adjust things like graphics, controls, or audio before loading into the game, so everything’s set up how you want it right from the start

That’s everything for now! With both the Mustang and Appaloosa now available, there’s never been a better time to expand your stables and explore all the new patterns and dilutions. Whether you're mindlessly spinning your horse around in the creator or spotting fresh markings in the wild, we hope these additions bring some extra fun to your game.
Don't forget to join us on Discord to stay up to date on all things Rival Stars, chat with other players, and share your latest creations. We’d love to see what you’re working on.

Welcome back to another round of update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition!
In this update, we’re opening the gates to a brand new Free Roam location. Head past the show jumping arena and into the wilds.

Welcome to Canyon Falls—A fresh new area with a whole new look. Think rugged cliffs, winding canyons, and stretches of wild bush dotted with sunlit cacti. Everything’s bathed in warm, golden light, giving it a laid-back, Western feel.

You can gallop through wide open valleys, snap some sunset shots of your horse, or just take it easy by the peaceful waterfall that inspired the name. There’s also a cosy barn and a quiet pasture tucked into the canyon—perfect for those everyday, down-to-earth moments.
There’s plenty to uncover, and we can’t wait to see the photos you capture in this beautiful new environment
Something big is on the horizon in Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition
Starting May 2nd and running until July 9th, we’re launching a brand-new limited-time event: the Triple Peaks Championship.

This special event is made up of three separate races, each offering their own unique challenges and rewards. Each event is your chance to earn exclusive gear—but to complete the full tack set, you’ll need to take first place in all three races, as each one rewards a different piece.

Whether you're in it to win it or just along for the ride, there’s something here for everyone. Keep an eye out—more details will be coming soon, including the full lineup of events. The countdown to the starting gate has begun.

That’s everything for now! We hope you enjoy exploring Canyon Falls and getting a feel for its laid-back vibes. Don’t forget to share your favourite shots—we can’t wait to see your horses out in the wild. And with the Triple Peaks Championship just around the corner, now’s the perfect time to saddle up and start prepping.
Join us on Discord to stay in the loop, chat with other players, and catch the latest updates. See you at the starting gate!
See you at the starting gate!

Welcome to the latest update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition!

This time around, we’ve got something special for you— a brand-new Show Jumping arena that will test your skills with sharp turns and quick jumps. Plus, we’ve added 23 beautiful new horse coats to bring more variety to your stable.
So saddle up, and let’s jump right into the details!

Get ready to step into a brand-new Show Jumping arena, crafted to test your agility and technique. Whether you're a seasoned rider or a newcomer, this space offers a fresh challenge with a mix of quick turns and precise jumps.

This first release is just a taste of what’s to come. We’ve designed the arena to put your skills to the test with combinations that demand speed and control. It’s not just about clearing the jump—it’s about mastering each turn while anticipating the next.
You’ll also find a brand-new set of riding gear for your rider to match the occasion.
The Show Jumping arena is available now under Free Roam. We're excited to build on this feature in future updates, so give it a try and let us know what you think!

Welcome to the latest update for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition!
Today's update introduces two exciting additions to the game, both set to change how you take the reins of Rival Stars Horse Racing. Let's jump straight in!
As promised in our last round of update notes, we are thrilled to introduce the Majestic American Quarter Horse to the stables!

A celebrated icon in the equine world with a rich history dating back to colonial America, the American Quarter Horse is renowned for its versatility and incredible speed over short distances. This breed has made a name for itself in racing, represented in game with a +5 Acceleration and +2 Speed bonus, the American Quarter Horse is primed to excel in races demanding quick bursts of power and speed.

notes.title: How to get an American Quarter Horse

items.text: You have a few options to get an American Quarter Horse in the game: the Horse Creator, Breeding Screen, and Market.

We have all these new horses, but what happens if you breed them together? Previously, breeding two different breeds of horses would result in a 50/50 chance of receiving a foal of either breed. Well, that has all changed with this update!
Introducing Crossbreeding: a game-changing feature that lets you create unique foals by combining different breeds.
Crossbreed Definition: A horse with less than 90% of any particular breed is considered a Crossbreed.
Breeding Purebreds: Breed two different purebreds, and you’ll get a foal that’s a perfect 50-50 blend of its parents.

Crossbreeds can have up to four breeds in their genetic makeup, offering exciting combinations to explore. Imagine breeding a horse with an Arabian’s sprint energy and a Thoroughbred’s increased speed. This results in a foal with a stunning and unique visual blend and bonuses to support your preferred playstyle.

The exact outcome of your foal’s breed makeup is shown in the ‘Definite Breed Makeup’ on the Breeding Screen, ensuring you always know what to expect. With so many visual blends to discover, the possibilities are endless!
Check out our updated Breeding Guide in-game for a deeper dive into Crossbreeding. Get ready to mix, match, and create a stable of one-of-a-kind champions!

When breeding crossbreeds, you'll notice a change in how bonus stats are distributed compared to purebreds. Instead of having one stat at +5, the bonus will be split across the two breeds. For example, a Thoroughbred with +5 Jump and an Arabian with +5 Sprint will produce a crossbreed with +3 Jump and +3 Sprint. Discover the best breeding strategy to create top champions
We can't wait to see the incredible horses you'll create as you explore these exciting new features.
That wraps up this update, folks. Thanks for hanging out! Don't forget to stay tuned to the community for the latest news and competitions. Until next time, happy racing/riding, everyone!

We've made adjustments to improve the racing and riding experience in Rival Stars Horse Racing. Horse stats and gameplay balances have been adjusted across all game mods to allow smoother gameplay. Here's a breakdown of the changes and how they impact each game mode.
Agility: This stat now influences your horse's preferred position and stamina regain. A more agile horse will better maintain its preferred position and recover stamina.
Jump: Your horse's jump ability now affects its acceleration out of the starting gate. A better jump means a quicker start!

Distance Preference: Matching your horse's preferred distance with the race distance now has a greater impact. Ensuring your horse runs at its preferred distance will significantly boost its performance.
Surface Preference: Cross-country races now feature surface preferences. Choosing a horse that prefers the surface of the map you're racing on will enhance its performance.
Controls: Cross-country controls have been refined to give you better control over your horse around tight corners, enhancing overall performance on those more challenging courses.
Agility: Higher agility increases the size of the jumping zone, making jumps easier to clear.
Progression: The difficulty balance has been adjusted for a smoother challenge progression.

notes.title: Exciting news awaits in the latest update!

items.text: Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled ride as we introduce the Arabian and Selle Français horse breeds onto the tracks of Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition. A whole stable of surprises awaits you, so let's jump in!

Renowned for its beauty, intelligence, and endurance, the Arabian stands at 15.1 hands, boasting a distinctive face that adds to its majestic allure. Perfectly suited for any cross-country endeavour, this breed navigates diverse terrain easily and elegantly, reflecting centuries of selective breeding for agility and resilience.

Originating from France, the Selle Français combines strength, athleticism, and a willingness to please its rider, making it the ultimate sport horse. Standing at 16 hands tall, these majestic creatures possess powerful hindquarters, enabling them to excel at jumping over obstacles with unparalleled prowess. With their blend of majesty and patience, Selle Français horses are esteemed champions in the field, making them an ideal choice for Steeplechase.
These stunning new breeds are now available in-game, eagerly awaiting a new companion. They can be found within the Market, breeding screen Stud List, and the Horse Creator mode.
With the introduction of these new breeds, we've implemented some adjustments to highlight the
power and individuality of each horse. We refer to these as breed bonuses.
A breed bonus is the additional stats a horse receives at birth based on its breed. Keeping that in mind, let’s explore what makes each breed unique.
The Arabian's breed stat bonus of +5 to Sprint Energy and +2 to Agility makes it a formidable competitor in endurance challenges and Cross-Country events,
With a bonus breed stat of +5 in Jump and +2 in Acceleration, they excel in Steeplechase competitions, showcasing their agility and speed with finesse.
With a bonus breed stat of +5 in Acceleration and +2 in Sprint, they shine in Flat Racing competitions, demonstrating their speed and mastery in dominating the track.

Currently, breeding between different horse breeds results in a 50/50 chance of obtaining either breed. Patterns, colours, and dilution may be inherited from both breeds, creating distinctive and unique combinations.
You can also pass on your legacy (see previous update notes) to a different breed allowing you to have a legacy of champion horses that span across disciplines.

We've got some neat updates in the pipeline and we're excited to share them with you. These include tweaks to free roam, bringing in fresh patterns, and unveiling a completely new breed. Stay tuned as we'll have more details about these upcoming changes to share with you soon.
That wraps up this update, folks. Thanks for hanging out! Don't forget to stay tuned to the community for the latest news and competitions. Until next time, happy racing/riding, everyone!

items.text: This update takes us back to the roots, to the days when your grandfather managed the ranch with his loyal horse, Destiny’s Dream.
Francis stumbled upon something we think will pique your interest.

Take the reins of your very own legacy horse, a descendant of your grandfather's horse. The legacy horse brings a whole new level of connection and bonding to your ranch, allowing you to pass down the legacy of your grandfather's horse through generations.

notes.title: What makes a legacy horse so special?

items.text: Besides being a descendant of your grandfather's horse, legacy horses come with some pretty neat genetic advantages. Thanks to your special ties with the bloodline, the horse will now gain an extra experience boost.

notes.title: How do I get a legacy horse?

items.text: As we mentioned earlier, finding these incredible horses was all thanks to the wonderful Francis.
Here he will inform you that he has found a bunch of Destiny’s Dream descendants, and its now your choice to pick which new equine friend you would like to bring home.
Enter Custom horse mode, Starting at Grade 3, you can choose your dream Legacy horse from a wide range of coats and colours.

notes.title: I have a legacy horse, what now?

items.text: You can continue your lineage of legacy horses by continuing to breed using the initial legacy horse, with the end goal being to raise a champion horse from the same bloodline.

Your legacy will be able to be passed along to the offspring as long as the offspring's grade is equal or higher to the lowest grade parent. To do so, head to the Manage Horse Screen of the Legacy horse and click Transfer Legacy, This will bring up a list of eligible legacy horses.

notes.title: Okay, let's talk about New Horse Breeds, where are they?

items.text: Previously we mentioned new horse breeds are coming to Rival Stars Horse Racing Desktop Edition, the initial plan was to have the update released by the end of Quarter one, unfortunately, we have had to push this update back a few months but we promise the wait will be worth it, with a few more surprises yet to reveal.
That’s all for this update folks. Thanks for hanging out, don’t forget to check out the community to keep up to date with recent news, and competitions. Until next time, happy Racing/Riding everyone

Welcome to the latest update notes for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition!

Exciting News! Stat Grading is now available with the latest update, version 1.21! Horses are now assigned letter grades (ranging from D for ordinary to A+ for the pinnacle of perfection) to signify their excellence in each stat. You can view these from your usual stat screen.

In 1.21, we've fine-tuned the process of foal stat inheritance, making it less random and increasing the likelihood of a foal having stats averaging those of its parents. - For instance, if the mare has “A+” Speed and the stud has “B” Speed, the foal is likely to have “A” Speed. However, if a foal is born at a higher grade than its parents, its stats won't be as high.
You can swap between letter and numbered stats on any screen stats are available.

The latest Update for Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition is here!
This update is all about photo mode and the incredible editions that have been added, so let's get into it.

Photo mode is now available in more places than before, including foal stalls, the pasture, and of course Free Roam. While you still have the ability to take stills using the provided backgrounds and poses, this takes in-game photography to a whole new level.
From the get-go, this new photo mode has a lot more features than the previous edition, these include, depth of field, lighting adjustments, filters, overlays, and appearance.

Once you have the desired shot lined up, you have the ability to hide the interface and snap the perfect shot using the f12 button. This will save your image to both your steam library and your default photo folder on your PC.
That's not all though.

While in photo mode, using a combination of the mouse and “W, A, S, D” on the keyboard, or the thumbsticks on the controller, players have full control of the camera meaning they can capture images at all new angles and distances.
To access photo mode in the Pasture and Foaling Stalls, head to the desired feature you wish to take photos from and hit the “Photo Mode” button.
Accessing Free Roam’s photo mode is a little different from the Pasture and Faoling stalls, once you are ready to take the photo hit the “Q” key to bring up the Photo Mode menu.
We are excited to see the exciting and wonderful moments you capture with the new and improved photo mode.

We are back with another exciting update for you all!
You have been honing your Cross Country skills for a few weeks and now it's time to put it to the ultimate test with the introduction of Cross Country Leaderboards!
For those who have played the mobile edition of Rival Stars Horse Racing, this will work differently from the leaderboards and Live events you have all grown to know and love

Leaderboards work in seasons with each season lasting for 2 weeks. New seasons kick off on Thursdays at 12:00 PM EST, giving every player the chance to prepare and train their horses to become Cross Country Champions.

Each Cross Country Course has its own Leaderboard, with Pro mode being integrated into its respective related course. To get to the top of the leaderboard, players need to not only beat the optimal time set for the course but also make sure they are completing the course faster than others. Scores/Times are connected to your steam ID, meaning you can only register one time for each course.
There are a few different ways to interact with the leaderboard.
The leaderboard will show the “world” leaderboard by default.

Selecting the friend button next to the leaderboard will shift the leaderboard view from the world leaderboards to a friends-only view showing you how you are doing in the current season vs your friends.
To view the leaderboard for the current season or take a look at the past season's winners you’ll want to click the “Trophy” Icon at the top of the leaderboard.
In the meantime, players will be competing for bragging rights. However, we are collecting feedback and will be evaluating the best way to reward the season winners
We can't wait to see everyone compete and start climbing the leaderboard!
Don’t forget to check out the community to keep up to date with the recent news, and competitions. Until next time, happy Racing/Riding everyone.

We are proud to announce the latest game mode in Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition — Cross Country!
That’s right! You've been training your Jump and Agility stats for a few months now and it's finally time to put them to use!
What is Cross Country?

You've already had a small taste of Cross Country with the addition of jumps in the free roam area, but now it's time for a true challenge. Cross Country is the ultimate test for your horse’s speed, endurance, and jumping skills. Scoring is kept true to real life, which means to land the medal you are after, you have to navigate your way through the tracks, execute those perfect jumps, and complete the track as close to the set time as possible!
Nail all these elements and you’ll be well on your way to being a Cross Country champion.
Accessing Cross Country can be done in the Race and Ride menu once you have reached Prestige 4. From there, you need to select your course and the horse you wish to compete with.

By completing each event within a certain time frame, you will begin to unlock new tracks. Every track has eligibility criteria that are dictated by the horse's level, meaning the higher you train your horse the more tracks it can compete on.
Pro is a second difficulty level for those who really want to challenge their Cross Country abilities.

You can access Pro difficulty by changing the difficulty toggle on the Cross Country course select screen, but it will only become available once you have unlocked and completed all the tracks on Normal difficulty.

Hello, and welcome to the Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition, Greener Pastures Update!
Welcome to your brand new Pasture!

The Pasture is a brand new beautiful plot of land you have recently acquired allowing you to transport and store your horses. You can move your horses from your stables and into the Pasture for retirement reasons, or maybe you just need to free up space in your stalls.

The Pasture is not just a storage box for your horses! Starting from Prestige 6, you can move your horses to and from the pasture! This can be done by clicking on the Pasture button in your stables, here you have the opportunity to view your horses interacting with each other and enjoying their time rolling in the grass, but that's not all, the Pasture allows you to have full camera control to get the best angles on your horses.

It is important to remember that If your horse is placed in the pasture you will not be able to race, train or breed with it until you return the horse to your stables, However, you are still able to take your horse out on a Free Roam adventure!

notes.title: How do I place a horse in the Pasture?

items.text: Moving your horses to and from the Pasture is simple! Start by selecting the horse you wish to move from your stable and click the “manage horse button” on the top right of your screen (this appears as a horse/gear icon) From here you will see the option to “Move To Pasture” button, clicking this will successfully move your selected horse to the Pasture.

Bringing a horse back from the Pasture is much the same. First head to the Pasture from the stables, Select the horse you wish to return, select “Manage Horse” and confirm the transfer back to the stable by selecting “Move To Stables”

notes.title: How many horses can I have?

items.text: No longer do you need to consider how many stalls you have available when breeding or purchasing a new horse because your Pasture space is able to hold up to a massive 60 horses at one time.

We are constantly working to improve and expand the world of Rival Stars Horse Racing, so please keep leaving your feedback so we can continue to build on and help make Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition the best Horse Racing Game, not just on Steam but in the world!

This is just the first installment of updates released this year, and we look forward to bringing you new content and new features in the future. Have fun and we’ll see you next time!
